offer.text: They're massing thick and we're too few. Hold the village heart with me and put down a dozen before sunrise — if dawn finds them inside the walls, we've lost.

accept.text: Then we hold till dawn. Steady now.

decline.text: Then we sell the square dearly without you.

in_progress.text: Dawn's a long way off. Keep cutting them down!

ready.text: A dozen down and grey light on the wall. We held.

complete.text: You stood the whole night through. They'll tell this one for years.

failed.text: Dawn came and they were still among the houses. A black night for us all.
